title: Scientists Swore This Fish Died Out With the Dinosaurs

scenes.text: Scientists swore this fish died out with the dinosaurs. Then one turned up in a fishing net.
December 1938, South Africa. A trawler hauled up a five-foot, steel-blue fish nobody on board could name.
A museum curator realised it was unusual. An expert confirmed it: a coelacanth.
Fossils said the coelacanth vanished about 70 million years ago.
It had simply been hiding in deep water off Africa the whole time.
Scientists studied its fossils for a century, never knowing the real fish was still swimming. Extinct? Not even close.

description:
Scientists believed the coelacanth died out about 70 million years ago.
Then, on 22 December 1938, a trawler off South Africa's coast caught one, about five feet long, and a museum curator and an expert identified it.
What other animal do you think could still be hiding out there?
